headline: Disney's (DIS) Earliest Mickey Mouse Set to Enter Public Domain
summary:
Walt Disney’s DIS earliest version of Mickey Mouse, specifically the Steamboat Willie persona created in 1928, is entering the public domain after 95 years of copyright protection in the United States. This marks the end of Disney's exclusive rights to the character's original form.

The earliest iteration of the company’s mascot could now be used in films, video games and other media without permission from its previous copyright holder.
